page_title: REI 2-1 REN | Reims v Rennes 01/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+7' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Steve Mandanda pulls off an easy save.
90+6' That's a clear yellow card. Leo Ostigard (Rennes) goes into the book.
90+5' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) jumps into a tackle and Mathieu Vernice signals a foul. Reims are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90+2' Joseph Okumu (Reims) earns the yellow card.
90+1' The free kick from close range, taken by Reims, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) commits a rough foul. Mathieu Vernice stops the game and makes a call. Reims have been awarded a free kick.
89' A corner kick by Rennes is thwarted by the well prepared Yehvann Diouf (Reims).

88' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Yehvann Diouf easily deals with the threat. Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
86' That's the end of the game for Buta, who is replaced by Thibault De Smet (Reims).
84' Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes) sends a cross into the box, but Yehvann Diouf comes off his line to gather the ball.

82' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
81' Luka Elsner has decided to make a change. Cedric Kipre (Reims) replaces Keito Nakamura.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Reda Khadra (Reims) will replace Junya Ito.
76' Junya Ito (Reims) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
76' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle after Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. A free kick to Reims.

74' Keito Nakamura (Reims) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Steve Mandanda tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
73' A substitution has been made. Ludovic Blas is replaced by Henrik Meister (Rennes).
72' The referee allows time for a substitution. Glen Kamara will be replaced by Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes).
72' Julien Stephan decides to make a substitution. Hans Hateboer will be replaced by Lorenz Assignon (Rennes).
72' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Yaya-Kader Fofana limps off the pitch to be replaced by Teddy Teuma (Reims).
72' Substitution. Amine Salama (Reims) on for Oumar Diakite.
71' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
70' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Yehvann Diouf pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
70' Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
68' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
68' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
67' Mathieu Vernice interrupts the game. One of the players from Reims won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. It's a free kick to Rennes in a dangerous position.
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Alidu Seidu (Rennes) is replacing Adrien Truffert.
64' Here is a change. Arnaud Kalimuendo is going off and Julien Stephan gives the last tactical orders to Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes).
64' Junya Ito (Reims) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Steve Mandanda, who smothers the ball.
62' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
61' Azor Matusiwa (Rennes) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
58' Oumar Diakite (Reims) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Steve Mandanda.
55' Handball! A player from Reims handled the ball. Rennes are awarded a free kick.
55' Junya Ito (Reims) takes a direct free kick.
54' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. That's a free kick to Reims.
53' A yellow card for a tackle by Adrien Truffert (Rennes). Mathieu Vernice doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
51' Oumar Diakite (Reims) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
50' The game is interrupted now, Oumar Diakite (Reims) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
49' 2 - 1 Goal! Junya Ito picks out Oumar Diakite (Reims) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the left side of the goal with a header from close range. 2:1.
47' What a big chance! Amine Gouiri (Rennes) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
46' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yehvann Diouf intercepts the ball.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Great touch by Amine Gouiri (Rennes) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' A pass by Junya Ito (Reims) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
44' A player from Rennes takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Reims.

41' 1 - 1 Yaya-Kader Fofana sends a superb cross into the box. Junya Ito (Reims) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the bottom left corner, leaving Steve Mandanda beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:1.
41' Junya Ito (Reims) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
40' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Junya Ito (Reims), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
39' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul. Reims will take a free kick near the side line.
36' A player from Reims commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Rennes are awarded the free kick.
36' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

34' Junya Ito (Reims) latches onto a pass and lets fly at goal from the edge of the box. The shot beats the keeper but smashes against the crossbar. Good effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
32' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' Buta (Reims) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Mathieu Vernice ignores the protests.
30' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
29' Glen Kamara (Rennes) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The linesman makes the right call and Rennes will have a corner.

28' It looks like Keito Nakamura (Reims) saw red with that tackle. Mathieu Vernice won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Rennes are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
27' The Rennes players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
24' The resulting set piece from Reims is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
24' Reims can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
23' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
22' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
22' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
20' Keito Nakamura (Reims) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

18' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Albert Gronbaek (Rennes). Mathieu Vernice saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Reims, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

17' Oumar Diakite (Reims) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.

13' 0 - 1 Leo Ostigard (Rennes) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 0:1.
13' Good work from Rennes as they win a corner.
12' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and Rennes manage to earn a corner.

11' Hans Hateboer (Rennes) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
11' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Rennes.
9' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) rises above the defence and heads a precise cross towards the left post. His effort, however, is blocked by Yehvann Diouf, who pulls off a stunning save!
9' He should have scored! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
9' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.

7' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Steve Mandanda leaps like a salmon to deny him.
2' Oumar Diakite (Reims) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Reims will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Mathieu Vernice.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
